name: ZEPLIN
full_name: ZonEd Proportional scintillation in LIquid Noble gases
summary: A historical liquid-xenon dark-matter programme at Boulby in the UK, studying single- and dual-phase xenon technology. ZEPLIN-III's high-field dual-phase approach later contributed to LZ.
detection_principle: ZEPLIN-I primarily used scintillation. Later dual-phase detectors measured scintillation and ionization together to distinguish nuclear from electron recoils.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
